products.name: Net Leased Commercial Property Leasing
products.description: Ownership and leasing of a diversified portfolio of freestanding, commercial real estate properties in the United States, primarily retail, under long-term triple-net leases. Properties are physically acquired, managed, and leased to tenants, with tenants responsible for most property expenses.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Loans and Investments
products.description: Origination and acquisition of commercial loans and other investments secured by real estate or ownership interests in real estate entities. These are financial products, including construction loans, mortgage notes, and sale-leaseback financing, delivered through capital deployment and underwriting.

products.name: Critical Subsystems and Modules for Semiconductor Equipment
products.description: Designs, engineers, manufactures, and tests complex subsystems and modules such as gas and fluid delivery systems, chemical delivery modules, wafer transport systems, process modules, and sub-fab process equipment support racks, primarily for semiconductor and display capital equipment markets. These are physically manufactured, highly engineered assemblies delivered to OEMs and device makers.

products.name: Parts and Components for Semiconductor and Industrial Applications
products.description: Manufactures and supplies a wide range of parts and components including ultra-clean valves, high purity connectors, industrial process connectors and valves, pneumatic actuators, manifolds, hoses, pressure gauges, gas line and component heaters, and complex weldments for semiconductor, oil and gas, chemical, power, and other industrial markets. These are precision-manufactured physical products.

products.name: Precision Robotics Systems
products.description: Designs and manufactures precision robotic systems for applications requiring accurate controlled motion, such as semiconductor wafer and chip handling, wire bonding, and industrial equipment. These are engineered, physical robotic products integrated into manufacturing processes.

products.name: Ultra-High Purity Parts Cleaning and Coating Services
products.description: Provides outsourced, validated ultra-high purity cleaning and coating services for process tool chamber parts, including process optimization and tool part life extension, primarily for semiconductor device manufacturers and wafer fabrication equipment markets. These are in-person, regulated services performed at specialized facilities.

products.name: Micro-Contamination Analytical Services
products.description: Offers analytical verification and micro-contamination analysis of tool parts, wafers, chemicals, cleanroom materials, deionized water, and airborne molecular contamination, supporting process tool chamber part cleaning effectiveness. These are laboratory-based, technical services for semiconductor manufacturers.

products.name: Cancer Diagnostic Testing Services
products.description: Specialized diagnostic testing services for hematologic (blood-related) cancers, including molecular diagnostics, cytogenetics, and advanced laboratory analyses. These services are performed in fully equipped clinical laboratories and delivered to physicians, hospitals, and laboratories, requiring regulated infrastructure, specialized personnel, and in-person laboratory operations.

products.name: Proprietary Diagnostic Assay Kits
products.description: Proprietary diagnostic assay kits, including HemeScreen and IV-Cell, developed, manufactured, and commercialized for use by other clinical laboratories. These kits are designed to improve laboratory workflow, testing accessibility, and diagnostic accuracy, and are distributed through laboratory partners and commercial channels. Production involves laboratory R&D, manufacturing, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Antibody-Based Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: Proprietary antibody-based drugs, including bispecific and monoclonal antibodies, developed through in-house discovery and external licensing, manufactured via third-party contract manufacturing, and delivered as injectable biologics for the treatment of various solid and hematologic tumors. These therapeutics are advanced through clinical trials and intended for commercialization upon regulatory approval.

products.name: Cleaning and Disinfecting Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed under brands such as Clorox, Pine-Sol, Scentiva, Tilex, Liquid-Plumr, Formula 409, and Poett, these products include home care cleaning, disinfecting, and laundry additives. They are produced through large-scale chemical manufacturing and distributed via retail and professional channels.

products.name: Professional Cleaning and Disinfecting Products
products.description: Sold under the CloroxPro and Clorox Healthcare brands, these products are designed for institutional, janitorial, food-service, and healthcare customers, requiring specialized formulations and compliance with regulatory standards. Delivered through direct sales and distribution networks.

products.name: Bags and Wraps
products.description: Produced primarily under the Glad brand, this line includes trash bags, food storage bags, and wraps. These products are manufactured using resin and other materials and distributed through mass retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Cat Litter Products
products.description: Manufactured under brands such as Fresh Step, Scoop Away, and Ever Clean, these products are produced using mineral and chemical processing and are distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Grilling Products
products.description: Marketed under the Kingsford brand, these products include charcoal briquettes and related grilling accessories, produced through physical manufacturing and distributed seasonally through retail outlets.

products.name: Food Products (Dressings, Dips, Seasonings, Sauces)
products.description: Produced primarily under the Hidden Valley brand, this line includes salad dressings, dips, seasonings, and sauces, manufactured using food processing and packaging facilities and distributed through retail and food service channels.

products.name: Water-Filtration Products
products.description: Marketed under the Brita brand, these products include water pitchers, filters, and related accessories, produced through assembly and filtration technology manufacturing and distributed globally via retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Natural Personal Care Products
products.description: Sold under the Burt’s Bees brand, this line includes natural personal care items such as lip balms and skincare products, manufactured using natural ingredients and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: IB-Stim Neuromodulation Therapy Devices
products.description: A non-implantable, percutaneous electrical nerve field stimulation (PENFS) device for neuromodulation therapy, primarily used to treat functional abdominal pain associated with irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), functional dyspepsia (FD), and associated FD nausea symptoms in patients 8 years and older. The device is manufactured in Indiana and delivered through trained healthcare providers in outpatient clinical settings.

products.name: RED (Rectal Expulsion Device)
products.description: A point-of-care, office-based medical device used by healthcare providers to evaluate neuromuscular function for rectal expulsion and to qualitatively test for rectal hypersensitivity in adult patients with chronic constipation. Manufactured in Michigan, it is designed for use in clinical settings to aid in diagnosis and treatment planning.

products.name: NSS-2 Bridge Neuromodulation Device
products.description: A percutaneous nerve field stimulator (PNFS) device for the reduction of symptoms of opioid withdrawal. Previously licensed to and marketed by Masimo as the Masimo Bridge, the device is now back under Neuraxis' control. It is a wearable, non-implantable device used in clinical settings for opioid withdrawal management.

products.name: Hospitality and Restaurant Services
products.description: Operation and ownership of fine dining and casual dining restaurants, cocktail bars, nightlife and entertainment venues, primarily through wholly owned and joint venture concepts, including partnerships with Jean-Georges Restaurants. Delivered via physical locations requiring in-person service, culinary expertise, and regulated food and beverage operations.

products.name: Live Entertainment and Concert Venues
products.description: Operation of live music and entertainment venues, most notably The Rooftop at Pier 17, hosting concerts and events. Requires physical venues, event management, ticketing, and in-person attendance.

products.name: Professional Sports Team Operations
products.description: Ownership and operation of the Las Vegas Aviators Minor League Baseball team, generating revenue from ticket sales, concessions, merchandise, and sponsorships. Involves management of a professional sports franchise and related in-person events.

products.name: Sports and Special Event Venue Management
products.description: Operation and management of the Las Vegas Ballpark and other event spaces, hosting baseball games and a variety of special events such as holiday attractions, tours, and movie nights. Requires physical venue management, event planning, and community engagement.

products.name: Experiential Retail and Entertainment Destinations
products.description: Development and management of mixed-use real estate assets integrating retail, entertainment, and hospitality, such as the Seaport in Lower Manhattan, offering immersive experiences and unique environments for visitors and tenants. Involves physical real estate, leasing, and event programming.

products.name: Event Hosting and Sponsorship Services
products.description: Provision of event hosting services for public and private events, including concerts, festivals, and corporate gatherings, as well as selling sponsorship opportunities tied to these events and venues. Delivered through in-person event management and marketing partnerships.

products.name: Real Estate Leasing and Landlord Services
products.description: Leasing of retail, restaurant, office, and residential spaces within owned properties, primarily at the Seaport, to external tenants. Involves property management, tenant relations, and regulated real estate operations.

products.name: Development of Hospitality and Entertainment Real Estate
products.description: Development and potential monetization of new hospitality and entertainment-focused real estate projects, such as the Fashion Show Mall Air Rights, which may include new casinos, hotels, or entertainment venues. Requires capital investment, construction, and regulatory approvals.

products.name: Self Storage Leasing
products.description: Leasing of self storage units to individuals and businesses across a geographically diversified portfolio of properties. This is a physical real estate service requiring property ownership, management, and maintenance.

products.name: Property Management Services
products.description: Management of self storage properties for unconsolidated real estate ventures and third-party owners, including day-to-day operations, tenant services, and facility maintenance. Delivered through an internally-staffed management platform.

products.name: Tenant Insurance and Warranty Protection Programs
products.description: Facilitation of insurance and warranty protection programs for tenants at self storage properties, earning a share of proceeds. These are financial products offered in partnership with insurance providers.

products.name: Truck Rentals and Packing Supplies
products.description: Provision of ancillary moving-related services such as truck rentals and sales of packing supplies to self storage tenants. These are physical products and services offered at storage locations.

products.name: Electric Utility Services
products.description: Generation, purchase, and distribution of electricity to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in a regulated service area, using a mix of owned and leased generation facilities, including coal, natural gas, and renewable sources. Delivered via regulated infrastructure and subject to state and federal oversight.

products.name: Natural Gas Utility Services
products.description: Purchase, transportation, and distribution of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in a regulated service area, using pipeline interconnections and storage facilities. Delivered via regulated infrastructure and subject to state and federal oversight.

products.name: Renewable Energy Programs
products.description: Provision of renewable energy solutions, including solar and wind generation, battery storage, and customer programs such as Renewable Energy Rider and Shared Solar, enabling customers to purchase or subscribe to renewable energy. Delivered through owned generation assets and regulated customer programs.

products.name: Electric Vehicle Charging Services
products.description: Provision and operation of a network of electric vehicle charging stations, including fast charging hubs powered by renewable energy, for public and commercial use. Delivered via physical infrastructure in the service area.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas Programs
products.description: Voluntary programs enabling customers to offset or reduce emissions associated with natural gas consumption, including the purchase of renewable thermal credits and the injection of renewable natural gas into the distribution system. Delivered through contractual arrangements and infrastructure modifications.

products.name: Nonregulated Electric Generation Leasing
products.description: Ownership and leasing of electric generating capacity (such as the Elm Road Units and West Campus Cogeneration Facility) to the regulated utility, providing additional generation resources. Delivered through long-term lease agreements with the utility.

products.name: Electric Transmission Investments
products.description: Equity investments in companies that own and operate electric transmission facilities, primarily through American Transmission Company LLC and ATC Holdco LLC, generating returns from transmission operations. Delivered as financial investments rather than direct service provision.

products.name: Smart Security Cameras and Video Doorbells
products.description: A range of wireless, Wi-Fi, and LTE-enabled security cameras and video doorbells for home and business use, featuring HD/2K/4K video, AI-powered detection, two-way audio, and integration with cloud services. Devices are physically manufactured and sold through retail, online, and channel partners.

products.name: Home Security Systems
products.description: Comprehensive smart home security systems featuring multi-sensor devices capable of detecting motion, entry, water leaks, temperature, and alarms, managed via a mobile app and integrated with professional monitoring services. These are physical products manufactured and sold to consumers and businesses.

products.name: Floodlight Cameras
products.description: Battery-powered and wired floodlight cameras combining high-lumen lighting, HD video, two-way audio, and smart detection, designed for outdoor security and integration with smart home platforms. These are physical devices manufactured and sold to end customers.

products.name: Personal Safety Solutions
products.description: Personal safety services and devices, including a panic button accessory and mobile app, offering 24/7 emergency response, location sharing, and family safety features for individuals on the go. Delivered as a combination of physical device and digital service.

products.name: Security System and Camera Accessories
products.description: A variety of accessories such as sirens, battery and cellular backup modules, charging stations, solar panels, and mounting solutions designed to enhance and support Arlo security devices and systems. These are physical products sold separately to customers.

products.name: Cloud-Based Security Subscription Services
products.description: Subscription-based digital services providing cloud video storage, AI-powered detection, emergency response, professional monitoring, and advanced notification features for Arlo devices. Delivered via a SaaS model and mobile app integration.

products.name: Smart Security Cloud Platform (Arlo SmartCloud)
products.description: A SaaS platform offering advanced cloud-based security services, including computer vision, multi-object detection, audio analysis, and scalable storage, targeted at businesses and third-party hardware/service providers for integration into their own offerings.

products.name: Pharmaceutical and Nutrition Ingredients
products.description: Manufactured excipients, controlled release polymers, disintegrants, tablet coatings, thickeners, solubilizers, and binders for oral solid dosage drugs and functional food applications. Delivered via global manufacturing and lab facilities, requiring regulated infrastructure and specialized chemical processing.

products.name: Personal Care Ingredients
products.description: Produced natural, nature-derived, biodegradable, and high-performance ingredients for skin care, sun care, hair care, oral care, and household cleaning products. Delivered through chemical manufacturing and encapsulation technologies, serving consumer product formulators globally.

products.name: Specialty Additives for Industrial Applications
products.description: Manufactures rheology and performance-enhancing additives, including thickeners, foam control agents, surfactants, wetting agents, and pH neutralizers for architectural coatings, construction, energy, automotive, and industrial markets. Products are produced in shared manufacturing facilities using synthetic and cellulosic chemistries.

products.name: Chemical Intermediates (BDO and Derivatives)
products.description: Produces 1,4 butanediol (BDO) and related derivatives, including n-methylpyrrolidone, used as chemical intermediates in engineering polymers, polyurethanes, and as specialty solvents for electronics, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, and water filtration. Manufactured at dedicated facilities and distributed globally.

products.name: Antibody Therapeutics
products.description: Discovery, development, and clinical advancement of first-in-class and best-in-class antibody medicines for high unmet medical needs, including internal pipeline assets and out-licensed programs. These are biologic drugs produced via proprietary discovery and protein engineering platforms, manufactured in-house for clinical trials.

products.name: Antibody Discovery and Optimization Services for Partners
products.description: Provision of antibody discovery, optimization, and development services to external biopharmaceutical and biotechnology partners, delivering optimized antibody candidates for further development. Revenue is generated through upfront payments, research fees, milestones, and royalties on partner-developed drugs. Services are delivered using proprietary technology platforms and scientific expertise.

products.name: Portfolio of Royalties and Milestone Payments from Partnered Antibody Programs
products.description: Financial participation in the commercial success of antibody drugs discovered or co-developed for partners, through contractual rights to royalties, profit-sharing, and milestone payments. This portfolio is a financial asset derived from historical and ongoing partnerships, not direct product sales.

products.name: Big and Tall Men's Apparel
products.description: A comprehensive range of big and tall men's clothing, including casual, business, activewear, denim, and tailored apparel, offered through both proprietary and national brands. Products are manufactured globally and sold via retail stores, outlets, and digital channels, with a focus on proprietary fit and extensive size options.

products.name: Big and Tall Men's Footwear
products.description: A curated selection of men's footwear in wide and large sizes (10W to 17W), including casual and formal shoes from both designer and value brands, sold primarily through the website and select stores.

products.name: Plus-Size Women's Apparel (FullBeauty Brands)
products.description: A broad assortment of plus-size women's clothing and accessories, including exclusive and national brands, delivered primarily through direct-to-consumer digital channels and catalogs, as part of the FullBeauty merger.

products.name: Big and Tall Men's Apparel via Digital Marketplaces
products.description: A select offering of big and tall men's apparel made available through third-party digital marketplaces such as Nordstrom, Amazon, and Walmart, expanding reach beyond proprietary channels.

products.name: Custom Big and Tall Apparel (via FiTMAP Technology)
products.description: Custom-fit big and tall men's apparel enabled by proprietary FiTMAP digital sizing technology, available in select stores and through the mobile app, offering personalized fit and potential for custom garments.

products.name: Full Truckload Transportation Services
products.description: Transportation of general commodities for customers using company-owned or independent contractor tractors and trailers, including dry van, refrigerated, drayage, dedicated, expedited, and cross-border truckload lanes. Services are delivered via a large, modern fleet and require significant physical assets, in-person labor, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) Transportation Services
products.description: Transportation of multiple shipments from multiple customers in the same trailer, utilizing a network of service centers and a dedicated LTL fleet. Requires significant investment in terminals, fixed assets, and operational infrastructure, and is delivered through a super-regional and expanding national network.

products.name: Logistics and Freight Brokerage Services
products.description: Matching customer shipping needs with capacity provided by third-party carriers and rail providers, including freight brokerage, freight management, and non-trucking logistics services. Delivered through digital platforms, technology, and a network of third-party providers, requiring less physical assets but significant information technology and coordination.

products.name: Intermodal Transportation Services
products.description: Transportation of freight using a combination of truck and rail, leveraging intermodal containers and agreements with major North American rail carriers. Requires investment in containers, tractors, and coordination with rail partners, serving longer haul lanes.

products.name: Marine and Off-Highway Power Transmission Equipment
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells power transmission equipment such as marine transmissions, azimuth drives, surface drives, propellers, boat management systems, power-shift transmissions, hydraulic torque converters, power take-offs, industrial clutches, control systems, and braking systems. These products are physically manufactured from materials like cast iron, aluminum, and steel, and are delivered to marine, energy, government, and industrial customers.

products.name: Custom Power Transmission Components and Gearboxes
products.description: Manufactures custom-designed, high-quality power transmission components and gearboxes for industrial and marine end-markets, involving precision engineering and physical manufacturing, primarily through the Katsa Oy acquisition.

products.name: After-Sales Services for Power Transmission Equipment
products.description: Provides after-sales services including spare part deliveries, reverse engineering, modeling, and gearbox refurbishment, primarily through Katsa Oy, involving technical support and physical servicing of equipment.

products.name: Marine Controls, Propulsion, Steering, and Braking Systems
products.description: Manufactures and sells controls, propulsion, steering, and braking systems for marine, oil and gas, and industrial markets, primarily through the Kobelt acquisition, involving physical manufacturing and engineering.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides loans to businesses, including commercial and industrial loans, operating lines of credit, machinery purchases, and commercial real estate loans. These are delivered through in-person banking and loan production offices, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Agricultural Lending
products.description: Offers loans to customers in the agricultural industry for farmland, farm equipment, livestock, operating loans for seed, fertilizer, and feed. Delivered through physical branches and loan production offices, requiring specialized underwriting and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Provides residential mortgage loans, including fixed-rate, hybrid, jumbo, and low-income homebuyer programs. Loans are originated and sometimes sold into the secondary market, with servicing often retained. Delivered via physical branches and digital channels, requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans for home improvements, autos, trucks, recreational vehicles, motorcycles, boats, and raw land. Delivered through branch network and digital channels, requiring credit underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides checking, savings, and time deposit accounts, including certificates of deposit, IRAs, and HSAs. Delivered through physical branches, ATMs/ITMs, and digital banking platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Offers online and mobile banking for consumers and businesses, including bill-pay, online statements, mobile banking, electronic transaction origination (wire, ACH), and remote deposit capture. Delivered digitally, requiring technology infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: ATM and Interactive Teller Machine Services
products.description: Provides access to cash and banking transactions through ATMs and ITMs at branch and independent locations, with ITMs offering remote teller assistance. Requires physical infrastructure and technology investment.

products.name: Insurance Products
products.description: Offers insurance products to customers through F&M Insurance Agency, LLC. Delivered via agency staff and digital channels, requiring licensing and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Investment Services
products.description: Provides investment and brokerage services to customers through FM Investment Services, including securities offered via Raymond James Financial Services. Delivered through licensed representatives and digital platforms, requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: Homebuilding (Single Family, Townhomes, Condominiums, Patio, and Luxury Homes)
products.description: Designs, constructs, and sells a broad range of new homes—including single family homes, townhomes, condominiums, patio homes, and luxury homes—through multiple builder brands in Texas, Georgia, and Florida. Homes are built using in-person labor, physical materials, and are delivered as finished residences to buyers.

products.name: Land Development and Lot Sales
products.description: Acquires, entitles, and develops raw land into finished lots, which are then used for internal homebuilding or sold to subsidiary builders. Involves physical development, regulatory approvals, and infrastructure construction.

products.name: Master-Planned Community Development
products.description: Plans, develops, and manages large-scale master-planned residential communities with amenities and common areas, integrating design, infrastructure, and lifestyle features. Delivered through physical development and ongoing management.

products.name: Mortgage Origination Services
products.description: Provides mortgage origination and financing solutions to homebuyers through its wholly-owned subsidiary, arranging loans with third-party lenders. Delivered digitally and through in-person support.

products.name: Title Services
products.description: Offers title insurance and closing services to homebuyers, facilitating the transfer of property ownership. Delivered through in-person and digital processes via a dedicated subsidiary.

products.name: Insurance Agency Services
products.description: Acts as an insurance agency offering home, auto, and personal insurance policies to homebuyers, placing policies with third-party carriers. Delivered through in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Human Capital Management Solutions
products.description: Technology-enabled services for implementing and administering employee benefits, including health, wealth, and leave solutions, delivered digitally via cloud-based platforms and mobile applications.

products.name: Professional Football Club Operations
products.description: Ownership and operation of professional football (soccer) clubs, generating revenue from media rights, matchday attendance, sponsorships, merchandise, and player transfers, with a focus on multi-club management and player development.

products.name: Investment Management Services
products.description: Active investment management and shareholder engagement, including managing investment funds and deploying capital in undervalued public companies to drive value-accretive change.

products.name: Casual Dining Restaurant Operations
products.description: Operation of casual dining restaurants under the O'Charley's and Ninety Nine Restaurants brands, providing in-person dining experiences and food services to consumers.

products.name: Fintech and Regtech Solutions
products.description: Provision of core processing, digital banking, managed cybersecurity, payments processing, and regulatory compliance solutions to financial institutions and corporate customers, delivered via software and managed IT services.

products.name: Insurance and Retirement Solutions Distribution
products.description: Development, marketing, and distribution of life and health insurance, annuities, and retirement planning solutions through a national network of agents and advisors.

products.name: Flavoring Products
products.description: Production and sale of high-quality flavoring products, including spices, seasonings, and extracts, manufactured from natural ingredients and distributed to consumers and businesses.

products.name: Distilled Spirits and Hospitality Services
products.description: Operation of estate distilleries producing American whiskey and white spirits, along with related hospitality venues and guest experience centers for visitors.

products.name: Rademikibart (IL-4Rα inhibitor)
products.description: A next-generation human monoclonal antibody targeting interleukin-4-receptor alpha (IL-4Rα), developed and delivered as an injectable biologic for the treatment of eosinophilic-driven respiratory diseases, specifically acute and chronic asthma and COPD, and previously atopic dermatitis. Manufactured via third-party contract manufacturing and administered via subcutaneous or intravenous injection.

products.name: Copper and Critical Metals Mining and Development
products.description: Exploration, development, and planned production of copper and other critical metals through physical mining operations, primarily via underground mining and heap leach processing to produce copper cathode. Projects are located in the United States (notably the Santa Cruz Copper Project) and internationally (Saudi Arabia, Chile, Colombia, Ivory Coast, Peru).

products.name: Minerals Exploration Services (including Typhoon™ Geophysical Surveying and Data Analytics)
products.description: Provision of advanced geophysical surveying services using proprietary Typhoon™ technology and Computational Geosciences Inc. (CGI) data analytics, offered to joint ventures, alliances, and third-party customers to accelerate and de-risk mineral exploration. Delivered through physical deployment of equipment and digital data processing.

products.name: Vanadium Redox Flow Battery Energy Storage Systems
products.description: Development, manufacturing, and sale of advanced grid-scale energy storage systems utilizing vanadium redox flow batteries, through VRB Energy and its subsidiaries. These systems are physically manufactured and sold for integration with renewable power sources, targeting utility and commercial customers globally.

products.name: Integrated Marketing Services
products.description: A comprehensive suite of marketing services integrating strategy, creative, production, media, analytics, and technology across physical and digital channels, delivered through a combination of in-house agencies and proprietary platforms. Services are tailored to client objectives and delivered via a mix of consulting, managed services, and executional support.

products.name: Commercial Printing Services
products.description: Production and distribution of a wide range of printed materials including catalogs, direct mail, in-store signage, displays, packaging, magazines, retail inserts, and directories, using advanced automation and large-scale manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Media Planning and Buying Services
products.description: Data-driven media strategy, planning, buying, and placement services for both digital and traditional channels, leveraging proprietary data and analytics to optimize campaigns and maximize ROI for clients.

products.name: Creative and Content Production Services
products.description: End-to-end creative services including brand strategy, design, photography, video, CGI, animation, and content creation, delivered through in-house creative agency and global studio network for activation across all channels.

products.name: Marketing Analytics and Data Services
products.description: Research, analytics, and proprietary data services including audience insights, segmentation, media measurement, and campaign optimization, powered by a household-based data stack and AI-driven platforms.

products.name: Client-Facing Marketing Technology Solutions
products.description: Proprietary technology platforms and tools for content management, campaign planning, workflow automation, and localized marketing execution, including AI-powered solutions for personalization and process optimization.

products.name: Managed Marketing Execution Services
products.description: End-to-end managed services acting as an extension of client marketing operations, covering creative intake, asset production, fulfillment, ordering, distribution, and analytics, with embedded on-site teams and vendor management.

products.name: In-Store Retail Media Network Services
products.description: Provision and management of in-store digital media networks (retail media networks) for retailers and CPG brands, delivering targeted digital advertising and promotions via digital screens in physical retail environments.

products.name: Postal Optimization and Mail Services
products.description: Postal optimization services including co-mailing, presorting, and mail logistics to reduce postage costs and improve delivery effectiveness for clients’ printed marketing materials, leveraging proprietary processes and USPS expertise.

products.name: Packaging Design and Production Services
products.description: Design and manufacturing of packaging solutions, including sustainable and innovative packaging for consumer packaged goods, supported by creative, research, and environmental consulting services.

products.name: Sustainability Consulting Services
products.description: Consulting services to help clients optimize packaging and marketing materials for sustainability, including audits, materials testing, and dashboard reporting to meet regulatory and consumer requirements.

products.name: Worksite Healthcare Solutions (QuadMed)
products.description: Provision of on-site and near-site primary and specialty healthcare centers, virtual primary care, and behavioral health programs for external employers through the QuadMed subsidiary.

products.name: Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR) Products
products.description: Minimally invasive heart valve replacement devices, primarily the SAPIEN family of valves, delivered via catheter-based procedures while the heart is still beating. These products are manufactured using animal tissue and fabricated materials, and are distributed globally to hospitals and clinicians.

products.name: Transcatheter Mitral and Tricuspid Therapies (TMTT)
products.description: Catheter-based repair and replacement systems for mitral and tricuspid heart valves, including the PASCAL, EVOQUE, and SAPIEN M3 systems. These devices are designed for minimally invasive treatment of valve regurgitation and are manufactured using bioprosthetic and fabricated materials.

products.name: Surgical Structural Heart Products
products.description: Surgically implanted tissue heart valves and related devices for aortic, mitral, and complex cardiac procedures, including the INSPIRIS RESILIA, KONECT RESILIA, and MITRIS RESILIA valves. These products are manufactured from animal tissue and fabricated materials and require open-heart surgery for implantation.

products.name: Pen Needles
products.description: Sterile, single-use medical devices designed for use with pen injectors to administer insulin or other diabetes medications. Manufactured at company facilities and distributed globally through retail, hospital, pharmacy, and institutional channels.

products.name: Insulin Syringes
products.description: Sterile, single-use syringes used to inject insulin drawn from vials, including both conventional and safety versions with features to protect against needlestick injuries. Produced in company manufacturing sites and distributed worldwide.

products.name: Safety Injection Devices
products.description: Medical devices designed to enhance injection safety, including safety pen needles and safety insulin syringes with mechanisms to prevent needlestick injuries. Manufactured and distributed through global channels.

products.name: AI Data Engineering and Training Services
products.description: Provision of large-scale, high-quality data collection, curation, labeling, and preparation services for training and post-training of AI systems, delivered through a combination of proprietary platforms, automation, and specialized human expertise.

products.name: AI Model Evaluation, Alignment, and Safety Services
products.description: Comprehensive evaluation of AI models, including capabilities, alignment, safety, red teaming, adversarial testing, and regulatory compliance, using human-in-the-loop frameworks and automated tools to ensure reliability and trustworthiness of AI deployments.

products.name: AI Enablement and Operationalization Services
products.description: Support for deploying, customizing, and integrating AI models into enterprise and government workflows, including model customization, workflow integration, context engineering, and continuous quality assurance, leveraging scalable platforms and domain expertise.

products.name: Synodex Platform (Medical Data Transformation)
products.description: A proprietary platform that transforms medical records into structured digital data for insurance and healthcare workflows, combining domain expertise, proprietary data models, and applied AI, delivered as a software-enabled service.

products.name: Agility PR Solutions Platform (Media Intelligence and PR Software)
products.description: A software platform providing media intelligence and public relations workflow solutions, enhanced with AI-driven monitoring, analytics, and content capabilities, delivered as a SaaS product to enterprises and agencies.

products.name: Federal AI Data Engineering and Enablement Services
products.description: Specialized data engineering, AI enablement, and evaluation services tailored for U.S. government agencies and contractors, focusing on secure, compliant, and mission-critical AI programs in defense, intelligence, civilian, and regulatory environments.

products.name: Flexible CIGS Photovoltaic Solar Modules
products.description: Manufactured using a proprietary roll-to-roll process that deposits a thin Copper-Indium-Gallium-diSelenide (CIGS) layer onto a flexible plastic substrate, these lightweight, durable, and customizable solar modules are designed for high-value, weight-sensitive applications such as aerospace, satellites, UAVs, and specialty terrestrial markets.

products.name: Custom Integrated Solar Power Solutions
products.description: Designs and develops finished solar power products and collaborates with partners to create integrated solutions for end-use applications such as satellites, spacecraft, airships, UAVs, and other vehicles, leveraging proprietary flexible PV modules to meet specialized customer requirements.

products.name: Unpackaged Rolls of CIGS Material for Integration
products.description: Produces and supplies finished, unpackaged rolls of CIGS photovoltaic material for shipment to customers worldwide, enabling them to encapsulate and integrate the material into their own products and applications.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Traditional deposit products including checking accounts, NOW accounts, savings accounts, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, and retirement accounts (such as IRAs), delivered through physical branches and digital channels, with FDIC insurance.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Secured and unsecured loans to businesses for working capital, business expansion, equipment purchases, and real estate acquisition or improvement, delivered through in-person relationship banking and subject to regulatory lending limits.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Secured and unsecured loans to individuals for purposes such as automobile financing, home improvements, education, and personal investments, delivered through branch and digital channels.

products.name: Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of fixed and variable rate mortgage loans for home purchase or refinance, with some loans sold into the secondary market and others held in portfolio, requiring regulatory compliance and specialized underwriting.

products.name: Investment Brokerage Services
products.description: Non-deposit investment products and brokerage services offered through a registered representative affiliated with LPL Financial, enabling customers to access securities and investment products not covered by FDIC insurance.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Insurance products offered to customers, including but not limited to credit life insurance and other types of insurance, typically in connection with credit transactions, delivered through licensed agents.

products.name: Online and Mobile Banking Services
products.description: Digital banking services enabling customers to access accounts, transfer funds, pay bills, and manage finances online or via mobile devices, supported by secure technology infrastructure.

products.name: Cash Management Services
products.description: Services for business customers to manage liquidity, including direct deposit of payroll, automatic drafts, and other treasury management solutions, delivered through digital and in-person channels.

products.name: Credit Card and Debit Card Services
products.description: Provision of MasterCard debit cards and VISA/MasterCard credit cards (through a correspondent bank), enabling customers to make purchases and access funds electronically, supported by national payment networks.

products.name: ATM Network Access
products.description: Access to cash and account services through participation in Nyce and Plus ATM networks, allowing customers to use ATMs regionally and nationally.

products.name: Safe Deposit Box Services
products.description: Rental of secure safe deposit boxes to customers for storage of valuables, delivered through physical branch locations.

products.name: Thermal Management Logistics Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive logistics services for the life sciences industry, utilizing proprietary packaging, information technology, and specialized cold chain logistics expertise to ensure the safe, effective, and compliant transport of temperature-sensitive products. Delivery involves physical transportation, advanced predictive technology, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Specialty Temperature-Regulating Packaging
products.description: Reusable, specialty packaging systems designed to maintain cryogenic or frozen temperatures for biological and pharmaceutical shipments. These packaging solutions are integrated with technology for tracking and are provided on a leasing model to reduce waste and cost. Physical manufacturing and logistics are required.

products.name: Emergency Preparedness and Response Services
products.description: Rapid deployment of crews and equipment for emergency logistics, including emergency preparedness plans, surge capacity, and compliance support for time-sensitive, temperature-controlled shipments. Services are delivered through in-person labor and specialized equipment.

products.name: Advanced Shipment Monitoring Technology (Sentry Monitoring)
products.description: Technology platform enabling real-time monitoring, recording, and archiving of shipment conditions (temperature, humidity, location) for regulatory and scientific purposes. Delivered as a digital solution integrated with logistics and packaging services.

products.name: Powered Shell Data Center Facilities
products.description: Core building structures with robust power connectivity and cooling infrastructure, delivered to tenants who complete internal fit-out. Requires physical construction, power and fiber infrastructure, and is delivered as a real estate and infrastructure product to hyperscalers and cloud providers.

products.name: Turnkey Data Center Solutions
products.description: Fully managed data center infrastructure including complete internal fit-out and ongoing facility management, allowing tenants to focus on compute workloads. Involves construction, installation of IT and networking equipment, and operational management.

products.name: Powered Land for Data Center Development
products.description: Acquisition and entitlement of sites with secured power, rights-of-way, environmental posture, and fiber connectivity, delivered as ready-to-develop land for data center operators. Involves land acquisition, permitting, and infrastructure preparation.

products.name: On-Site Power Generation Services for Data Centers
products.description: Provision of dedicated, behind-the-meter power generation (primarily natural gas-based) as a service to data center tenants, including equipment procurement, permitting, construction, and operation. Delivered through partnerships with energy providers.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Investments
products.description: Acquisition, development, management, and disposition of commercial real estate properties across various types including office, retail, hospitality, multifamily, land, and life science. These are physical assets requiring significant capital and are managed through direct ownership or joint ventures.

products.name: Real Estate Credit Investments
products.description: Provision and acquisition of real estate-backed mortgage debt, mezzanine loans, and preferred equity, including originating or purchasing loans secured by real estate or structured as preferred equity. These are financial products requiring capital and underwriting expertise, not physical assets.

products.name: Hospitality Property Operations
products.description: Ownership and operation of hospitality assets (hotels), including management, renovation, and leasing of hotel properties. This involves physical property management and in-person services, often through third-party hotel managers.

products.name: Self-Storage Property Investments
products.description: Investment in and ownership of self-storage real estate properties, either directly or through equity interests in self-storage businesses. These are physical assets requiring property management and capital investment.

products.name: Single-Family Rental Property Investments
products.description: Investment in single-family rental (SFR) properties, including direct ownership and equity interests in SFR-focused businesses. These are physical residential assets requiring property management and capital.

products.name: Life Science Real Estate Investments
products.description: Investment in life science real estate properties, including equity interests in companies or DSTs focused on life science facilities. These are specialized physical assets requiring capital and sector expertise.

products.name: Multifamily Residential Property Investments
products.description: Investment in multifamily apartment communities, including direct ownership and equity interests in multifamily-focused businesses. These are physical residential assets requiring property management and capital.

products.name: Other Real Estate Investments (Land, Industrial, Retail, Office)
products.description: Investment in other real estate property types such as land for development, industrial, retail, and office properties, either through direct ownership or equity interests. These are physical assets requiring capital and property management.

products.name: Non-Real Estate Securities Investments
products.description: Investment in non-real estate securities, including common and preferred equity, loans, CLOs, rights and warrants, convertible notes, bonds, litigation claims, and spectrum licenses. These are financial assets managed as part of a diversified investment strategy.

products.name: Gene Therapy for Neurodegenerative and Age-Related Diseases
products.description: Proprietary gene therapy platform using AAV and lentiviral vectors to deliver the Klotho gene (particularly the s-KL isoform) for the treatment and prevention of neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease and ALS. This involves in-licensed, patented technology and requires advanced biomanufacturing and regulatory approval.

products.name: Biosimilar Biologics for Oncology and Autoimmune Diseases
products.description: Development, manufacturing, and commercialization of biosimilar monoclonal antibodies (rituximab, trastuzumab, bevacizumab, cetuximab) for the treatment of cancer, autoimmune, and neovascularization diseases. These are produced using licensed technology and require large-scale biologics manufacturing and regulatory approval.

products.name: Generic Oncology Drugs
products.description: Portfolio of off-patent, market-approved generic drugs for the treatment of various cancers, including those used in FOLFOX and FOLFIRI regimens for metastatic colorectal, gastric, and lung cancers. These are manufactured and sold as standard generic pharmaceuticals.

products.name: Klotho Protein-Based Therapeutics
products.description: Development of recombinant Klotho protein (s-KL isoform) as a biologic infusion therapy for neurodegenerative and age-related diseases. This involves protein engineering, biologics manufacturing, and clinical development.

products.name: Klotho Isoform Diagnostic Assays
products.description: Development and potential commercialization of diagnostic assays to measure Klotho protein isoforms (s-KL, m-KL, p-KL, KL1, KL2) in blood and tissues, using monoclonal antibodies and separation technologies. These may be marketed as clinical biomarker tests if validated.

products.name: Critical and Precious Minerals Development and Mining
products.description: Development and mining of critical and precious minerals following the acquisition of Greenland Mines Corp. This involves physical extraction and processing of mineral resources, primarily in Europe.
